canonicalizationPolicy: Normalize duplicate mentions to one canonical connector id while preserving sources.
rules: Prefer the installed OpenAI curated connector when the task is inside Codex and both sources exist.
Prefer Claude official skill cards when the task is Claude Code planning or project-agent routing.
Keep duplicates as sources on one canonical connector instead of creating separate always-on entries.
Do not merge connectors with different accounts or permission surfaces unless the task scope is explicit.
